snippet.title: Last Flag | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hide. Hunt. Capture. The hunt for the flag begins April 14, 2026 at 10AM PT on Steam & Epic Games Store.  

Available Now on Steam and Epic Games Store!
Steam: https://bit.ly/4bLYoFf
Epic: https://bit.ly/4tng6VB

Coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S Summer 2026.

About Last Flag: 
Welcome to Last Flag: a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag. Last Flag is the debut title from Night Street Games, an independent game studio on a mission to build multiplayer games crafted with heart.



#lastflag #indiegame #capturetheflag #launchtrailer #steam #epicgames
